name: Holiday Scratch Turkey Bone Broth Gravy over Steamed White Rice
whyItWorks: Simmered holiday turkey drippings, rich turkey bone stock, and light flour roux ladled over soft, fluffy steamed white rice. Ultra-gentle on the gut, soothing, and packed with bioavailable collagen.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ladle warm, smooth strained turkey gravy over freshly steamed white jasmine or basmati rice with a pinch of sea salt.
